name: Oro Co Ltd
summary: Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1999, oRo Co., Ltd. specializes in delivering cloud-based services and driving digital transformation for businesses. The company's activities are bifurcated into two main divisions. Its Cloud Solutions segment develops and deploys ZAC, a cloud-native Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system tailored for the intellectual service sector, as well as Reforma PSA, a cloud-based Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform designed to automate back-office operations for the same industry. This division additionally offers bespoke system integration, IT infrastructure support, and business process outsourcing (BPO) services. Concurrently, the Marketing Communication segment provides comprehensive digital marketing solutions, prominently featuring the SEMrush suite. This arm is responsible for aiding clients with digital strategy formulation, promotional execution, strategic marketing planning, and orchestrating international communication campaigns. Furthermore, it delivers crucial business support for inbound and outbound marketing, test market evaluations, and e-commerce transactions.
